description: This file contains a PHP trait 'DecryptionTraitV2' which provides decryption methods for AWS SDK cryptographic operations, including decrypting ciphertext streams, validating options, and handling cipher specifics.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Main method for decrypting ciphertext using provided materials and metadata envelope.

methods.name: getTagFromCiphertextStream
methods.description: Extracts the authentication tag from the ciphertext stream for AEAD modes like GCM.

methods.name: getStrippedCiphertextStream
methods.description: Removes the tag part of the ciphertext stream, returning only the encrypted data part.

methods.name: validateOptionsAndEnvelope
methods.description: Validates cipher options and envelope metadata for decryption compatibility.

methods.name: getDecryptingStream
methods.description: Creates a decryption stream based on cipher type, currently supporting GCM and default cipher.
